name: skylark_check_in_flight
intent: Check in for a SkyLark flight
description: Starts SkyLark check-in for the flight to the requested city, selects the passenger, confirms no hazardous materials are being carried, confirms check-in, and returns the boarding pass details shown on completion.
patterns: Check me in for my flight
Check me in for my upcoming flight

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: Destination city of the flight to check in for

steps.intent: Tap Check in to start check-in for the flight to {{trip_city}}
Select the passenger to check in
Tap Continue after selecting the passenger
Toggle the confirmation that I'm not carrying hazardous materials
Tap Continue after confirming no hazardous materials
Tap Confirm check-in to complete check-in for the flight to {{trip_city}}
